disposition_reason: Ten commercially dried fish and shrimp species bought in Bangladeshi markets were analysed by EDXRF; Table 5 prints per-species means for 12 elements.

study.design: market survey of ten dried fish species with health risk assessment
study.origin: Bangladesh (fish harvested from various water bodies; sun-dried)
study.market: fish markets in Cox's Bazar and Chittagong region, Bangladesh
study.method: EDXRF (Cd-109 source, Si(Li) detector) on pressed pellets of dried edible muscle; calibration with IAEA-350 tuna
study.qa: DORM-2 dogfish muscle check: recoveries 86.7-109.2% (Table 1); precision 3-5%

regulatory_or_exposure.what: FAO/WHO wet-weight limits converted by the authors to dry weight using 77% moisture (Pb 2.17, Hg 2.17, As 4.35 mg/kg dw)
THQ, HI and cancer risk for adults and children

unresolved: Pb means of 0.001 mg/kg for eight species fall below the stated MDL (0.03 ppm); likely placeholder values, flagged.
Hg by EDXRF at 26-60 mg/kg dw is extraordinarily high for fish; no independent confirmation (e.g. CV-AAS) reported.
Whether samples were salted is not stated; described as sun-dried fish.
Abstract says samples collected from Cox's Bazar; methods say Cox's Bazar and Chittagong region.
